shortsPrograms.description: These shorts by Washington filmmakers will transport throughout our state.

shortsPrograms.title: Local Sightings 2026 – Origin Story (Shorts)
shortsPrograms.description: In this selection of shorts films, past becomes present as we explore the question: how do history and ancestry shape who we are?

shortsPrograms.title: Local Sightings 2026 – Queer As In (Shorts)
shortsPrograms.description: Free your mind and your ass will follow! Join us for films that explore every stage of queer life, from coming out to cruising to commitment.

shortsPrograms.description: These shorts feature the woods, rivers, and mountains of our region, and the PNW-ers who can't stop exploring them.

shortsPrograms.title: Local Sightings 2026 – Ways of Seeing (Shorts)
shortsPrograms.description: It's hard to be an artist. Join us for an exploration of what it means to continue making art in a world that's increasingly more hostile to it.

shorts.title: Anton Chekhov's The Student
shorts.description: Returning through the bitter cold from a failed Good Friday hunt, a disillusioned theology student recounts Peter’s biblical denial to two widows by a fire, revealing an unbroken chain of beauty and human suffering.

shorts.title: Arman
shorts.description:
(F
arzad Kiyafar
, Tacoma, 2024, 12min, in English and Persian with English subtitles)
Overwhelmed and isolated on his wedding day, a closeted immigrant speaks to his family on the phone moments before walking down the aisle.
Trailer

shorts.title: Augenblick: On the Edge of the Moment
shorts.description: Passing through multiple layers of transformation on their journey from oceanic blue to blood red, two dancers navigate the complexity of a relationship evolving over time. Augenblick is a series of three short films featuring two dancers (Carlos Osantinsky and Fernando Pelliccoli) with an uncanny ability to remain permeable to each other’s provocations without losing their own individuality. The German word “Augenblick,” which might be translated to “blink of an eye,” invokes both the moment and its ephemerality. Once you are aware of being in the moment, it is already over. Partners for over 20 years, Carlos Osantinsky and Fernando Pelliccoli are Argentine dancers living in Berlin who offer improvisation workshops through their company espaciopropio.augenblick. These tenderly playful duets, filmed in Berlin by American filmmaker Juliet McMains, offer insights from their decades-long practice of embodied exploration about the world through the body’s mutable boundaries.

shorts.title: Aurora Ave: Sunrise to Sunset
shorts.description: This documentary captures Seattle’s infamous Aurora Avenue from morning to night.

shorts.title: Bellybutton and the Monster Goat of the Mountain
shorts.description: The animated tale of a curious boy, a courageous grandmother, and a fearsome monster goat.

shorts.title: Best Friend Material
shorts.description: A horror comedy about a guys weekend gone wrong.

shorts.title: BLOWS
shorts.description: Blows explores layered effects of exploitation, surplus, and isolation on our collective consciousness in the western core of capital; the belly of the beast. It is a subtle testament to the dark absurdity of the current moment, as useless products and streams of thought intentionally creep into our internal landscapes. It investigates the possibility of hope and intention in a world meant to disempower us from every aspect of life.

shorts.title: Burnt Orange
shorts.description: When a wildfire threatens their home, a struggling artist and his more conventional partner are forced to confront their feelings about security, creativity, and each other.

shorts.title: Cambio
shorts.description: In this silent tale, Lux is a closeted young man who lives in a conservative household and confines the truth of his sexuality to his sketchbook. When he suddenly manifests the ability to project his fantasies onto screens and reflections, he accidentally outs himself to his parents.

shorts.title: Charlatans
shorts.description: In this abstract music video for Mutual Shock’s “Charlatans,” volatile mixtures of oil, water, and other reactive elements form shifting miniature worlds. Filmed in macro, these unstable chemical landscapes evoke the seduction, distortion, and collapse at the heart of the song.

shorts.title: Deliverance
shorts.description: A storm-battered scavenger wandering a desolate arctic wasteland begins to hear the voices of her estranged family.

shorts.title: Diamond Belly
shorts.description: Alex’s grandfather is dying of stomach cancer. When the old man starts claiming those aren’t tumours, but pilfered diamonds from a long-forgotten heist in the old country, family secrets and myths collide as Alex grapples with her newfound inheritance resting in a dying man’s stomach.

shorts.title: Dick's-A-Thon
shorts.description: 26 Miles, 5 Meals, 1 Wild Tradition. Learn about Seattle’s wackiest marathon and it’s mission to honor a friend, and give back to the outdoors.

shorts.title: Diwata
shorts.language: English and Tagalog with English Subtitles
shorts.description: After her granddaughter drowns, a secretly-magical Filipina grandmother (“Lola”) hides from the ocean she once loved. Five years later, fed up with her toxic family and 80th birthday, Lola returns to the sea. Using her magic, Lola resurrects her granddaughter, hoping to find herself, too.

shorts.title: Embrace
shorts.description:
(Matthew Rush, Washington, 2025, 9min, in English
When a bar bathroom hookup takes an otherworldly turn, two men must work through their problems to move forward.

shorts.title: Facing The Sun
shorts.language: English and Spanish with English Subtitles
shorts.description: An enigmatic, unhoused man spends his days giving free haircuts to the homeless – offering a lesson in love, and a window into the complex human dynamics at the center of America’s housing crisis.

shorts.title: Fadeaway
shorts.description:
Seattle premiere!
After a hookup text leads to the discovery of a deadly overdose, a closeted bisexual man is confronted by memories of his initial connection with the victim, and an old omen with newfound meaning.
Trailer

shorts.title: Freak Farm
shorts.description: A three-minute exploration of modernity and belonging, FREAK FARM incorporates phone footage, recorded sound, and audio effects to create an impressionistic, lyrical look at alienation and isolation. The film evokes a sense of discordance with its images, atmospheric texture, and editing.

shorts.title: Harmony Korine is A Weird Old Man
shorts.description: A four part ambiguation of “weirdness” in relation to the sublime. A sensory ode to incongruity. A brief and romantic gesture toward un-understanding. A prayer to the anti-self.

shorts.title: Hiroshi and Miss. Fujitome
shorts.description: Romance blossoms when a new hire starts at the office. However, nothing can start until someone musters up the courage to make a move.

shorts.title: If Tears Were Gold
shorts.description: A young punk musician returns home to rural Washington State to help care for their aging Nana Sally who is troubled by music no one else can hear. As Sally’s dementia deepens, a new song materializes uniting the family with a very unexpected and unlikely collaboration.

shorts.title: Late Shift
shorts.description: An established potter has an unexpected late night encounter with her apprentice; their divergent personal lives stir up emotional friction in the studio.

shorts.title: Lingering
shorts.description:
World premiere!
Jane ignores her best friend Ivy, who’s clearly pining for her, so that she can gain the attention and approval of a guy who clearly doesn’t give a shit about her.
Trailer

shorts.title: Long-Term Extramarital Affair
shorts.description: Long-Term Extramarital Affair is a short, animated film that explores the absurd reality of being trapped in two unfulfilling relationships at once. A husband and his long-time mistress decide to attend couples’ therapy. By the end all characters emerge with more self-awareness, and a touch of acceptance.

shorts.title: Look At This Freak
shorts.description: A reunion of old friends is disrupted by a hated roommate and an internet monstrosity.

shorts.title: Luxuries
shorts.description: Kim, a fashion-obsessed woman on the brink of homelessness, must choose between selling the last of her clothes or eviction.

shorts.title: Mallworld
shorts.description: A cynical filmmaker hired to produce infomercials for a group devoted to the mythical “Mallworld” becomes captivated by their lonely dream of finding a place where they truly belong.

shorts.title: MAN or MOUNTAIN
shorts.description:
Seattle Premiere!
Defying evacuation orders and denying scientific evidence, notorious lodge owner Harry R. Truman is sent cascading through memories of a life lived without regret on Spirit Lake, as mounting tremors rock his cherished world. Still basking in the limelight of his rebellion, imminent cataclysm calls him to finally face the bet he made against the very force of nature he built his life around.

shorts.title: Mother Goddess: Theater of Illusions
shorts.description: An experimental music video about a theater dreamscape full of spirits, clowns and giant puppets.

shorts.title: Once, a Second Time
shorts.description: Lump is a reclusive 20-something, trying to enjoy her fragile life with her lone friend, Jar. What little stability she has is shattered when her past finally catches up to her and she throws up a salmon in a dingy bar bathroom. To begin to thrive, she must decide if she can embrace vulnerability and open up not only to herself but to those who wish to help her.

shorts.title: Paper Trail
shorts.language: English and Yue Chinese (Cantonese) with English Subtitles
shorts.description: After 45 years, a second-generation filmmaker embarks on a mission to rediscover her mother’s roots and save what’s left of her family’s fading memories of their refugee journey to Canada. To do so, she must overcome one of the greatest challenges for every Asian kid – talking to their parents about the past.

shorts.title: Pepper's Meal
shorts.description: A woman enjoys a contemplative meal alone, as she has before and will again.

shorts.title: Qualia
shorts.description:
Dove, a repressed college student, languishes away her summer until Anya, a mesmerizing party girl crashes into her life and proves just how down bad she really is.
Trailer

shorts.title: Roll Modelz
shorts.description: As forces threaten to divide and silence Latino communities, a lowrider club in rural Washington transforms personal tragedy into a rolling act of resistance.

shorts.title: Sasquatch Sunrise
shorts.description: While scouting a location for a new drone delivery warehouse near the Skykomish River, consultants for a big tech company encounter unusual forms of resistance from the locals.

shorts.title: Shiphead (or, efforts in boycotting my American body)
shorts.description: A tarp-suited figure with a cargo ship head searches across forest, city, and sea. A humorous meditation on the global systems that shape—and inhabit—us.

shorts.title: So We Go On
shorts.description: After risking everything to keep his climbing gym alive, the child of immigrants wrestles with purpose, sacrifice, and his calling to create a space of belonging for others.

shorts.title: Sound Again
shorts.description: Sound Again is about a boy with degenerative hearing loss who decides, at the age of 12, to get cochlear implants. The procedure renders him technically deaf without the appliance (hearing devices), but leads to a new kind of “hearing.” Almost as a joke, he takes a high school music engineering class and discovers an unexpected talent for music. Incredibly, he becomes a talented, charismatic musician.

shorts.title: State Rep
shorts.description: Oregon State Representative Chad Biche has his sights set on Congress, taking every step to boost his ego, increase his credibility, and take as many selfies as possible. But when presented with the opportunity to make a real difference in the life of one of his constituents, will he have a change of heart?

shorts.title: Thank You, Stillman
shorts.description: Thank You, Stillman is a Super 8 mm travel diary from a 2021 visit to Brownsville, Texas. The film is made of images from the gulf coast—an abandoned waterpark, a lighthouse, marine debris, and newly erected rockets—set against the lyrics of Gene Autry’s That Silver Haired Daddy of Mine. Brownsville was founded by Charles Stillman, the great-great grandfather of writer and director Whit Stillman. Without Brownsville my paternal family would not exist, and neither would this film.

shorts.title: The Astronaut
shorts.description: In the 1980s, a lonely UFO enthusiast longing for human connection becomes convinced he has been contacted by extraterrestrial life.

shorts.title: The Carport
shorts.description: A documentary-tinged, meta-fiction bonanza about art, life, and the nature of performance. Simultaneously, a comedic love letter to Los Angeles: as a place, an idea, and a reluctant dream that the filmmaker investigates through gestures both intimate and antagonistic.

shorts.title: Three Sisters
shorts.description: When a plate of freshly fried fish is served, three sisters fall into a never-ending cycle of bickering and manipulation as the endlessly hungry middle sister schemes to eat everyone else’s share.

shorts.title: To Dress a Wound
shorts.description: To Dress a Wound is a poetry-driven experimental short exploring Black girl grief, rage, and daydreams, examining the emotional weight Black women and femmes carry under racial capitalism and patriarchy, and tracing how these histories live within the body across generations. The film explores a diasporic understanding of memory, including language. In moments of ancestral dialogue, Haitian Kreyol, Twi, and Lingala emerge. Subtitles remain in their original languages as an intentional choice.

shorts.title: UNBRAID ~ unravel
shorts.language: in English, Filipino (Tagalog), and Ibanag with English Subtitles
shorts.description: An adoptee filmmaker invites their adoptive mother, birth mother, and nanny to make a film about ritual, relationship, separation, and reunion.

shorts.title: Vanishing Seattle Presents: The Grand Illusion Cinema
shorts.description: After 55 years, The Grand Illusion Cinema in Seattle’s University District moved out of its original location. In 2023, the building that housed the cinema for decades was sold for $2.3 million, and the new landlord declined to renew their lease beyond February 2025. As The Grand Illusion searches for a new home, its vibrant history and legacy will live on.

shorts.title: Waking Up From a Nap on a Long Day of Doing Nothing
shorts.description: With the guidance of his best friend and mystical grandfather, a young painter – anxiously awaiting his first gallery show – embarks on a surreal skateboard odyssey through Portland to discover the true value of his art.

shorts.title: Walk and Talk
shorts.description: A coming-of-age drama shot on 16mm about Eve, a wild and aloof 16-year-old girl who takes a spontaneous night walk. With her thoughts and frustrations pouring out, Eve engages in a conversation with herself, exploring her identity, her neurodiversity and her place in the world.

shorts.title: What Settles the Dust?
shorts.description: A long-term relationship comes under threat as a new love enters the picture, causing a rift with no definitive resolution.

Defying evacuation orders and denying scientific evidence, notorious lodge owner Harry R. Still basking in the limelight of his rebellion, imminent cataclysm calls him to finally face the bet he made against the very force of nature he built his life around.

memberships.rawDescription: Sound Again is about a boy with degenerative hearing loss who decides, at the age of 12, to get cochlear implants. The procedure renders him technically deaf without the appliance (hearing devices), but leads to a new kind of “hearing.” Almost as a joke, he takes a high school music engineering class and discovers an unexpected talent for music. Incredibly, he becomes a talented, charismatic musician.

memberships.rawTitle: Augenblick: On the Edge of the Moment
memberships.rawDescription: Passing through multiple layers of transformation on their journey from oceanic blue to blood red, two dancers navigate the complexity of a relationship evolving over time. Augenblick is a series of three short films featuring two dancers (Carlos Osantinsky and Fernando Pelliccoli) with an uncanny ability to remain permeable to each other’s provocations without losing their own individuality. The German word “Augenblick,” which might be translated to “blink of an eye,” invokes both the moment and its ephemerality. Once you are aware of being in the moment, it is already over. Partners for over 20 years, Carlos Osantinsky and Fernando Pelliccoli are Argentine dancers living in Berlin who offer improvisation workshops through their company espaciopropio.augenblick. These tenderly playful duets, filmed in Berlin by American filmmaker Juliet McMains, offer insights from their decades-long practice of embodied exploration about the world through the body’s mutable boundaries.
